home.headline: I’m Walt. I photograph the people you love, in the light you’ll remember.
home.intro: Natural-light portraits of families, graduates, and athletes around Charlotte and Lake Norman. Tell me who you’d like photographed and I’ll plan the rest with you.
home.personalHeadline: I’d like you to feel comfortable working with me.
personalParagraphs: I’m a father of four, and I know getting everyone ready for pictures can take some doing. You can tell me if your children need time to warm up or someone isn’t looking forward to being photographed. I’ll keep the direction clear and give you room to settle in.
I also played football at Ohio State and professionally, which is part of why athlete portraits mean something to me. Whatever we’re photographing, I want to understand what matters to you first.

home.closingHeadline: Tell me who you’d like photographed and what you’re hoping for.

about.headline: Hi, I’m Walt Dublin.
about.intro: Photography began with my own family and the places we traveled, and it grew into a business because I enjoyed getting to know the people in front of the camera. I’m based in Charlotte and photograph individuals and families, graduates, and athletes in natural light. I’d like to hear what you have in mind, what matters to you about these photographs, and what would help you feel comfortable during your session.
about.sidebar: I’m a father of four, a former Ohio State and professional football player, a writer, and the person who will photograph your session.
paragraphs: I grew up in Sarasota, Florida, raised by my mother and my grandfather. The people who raised me are a big part of how I think about family and what we carry with us as we get older. That perspective comes with me when I photograph someone else’s family. I’m interested in the relationships between you, including the grandparent you want beside you and the parent who’s usually missing because they’re taking the picture. Those details help me understand which photographs matter to you.

Today, my fiancée and I have a blended family with four kids, from young children to teenagers. I know how much can happen before a family even gets to a session, from finding clothes that fit to persuading someone who would rather be with friends. I don’t expect you to arrive with everyone in the perfect mood. Tell me a little about your family beforehand, and we can plan around the people who are actually coming. I’ll offer direction and give everyone a chance to settle in.

Football was a big part of my life, from high school in Sarasota to Ohio State and professional football afterward. I remember how much effort goes into a season and how closely your life becomes tied to the people on your team. That experience shapes the questions I ask when I’m planning athlete portraits. I want to hear about your sport, the uniform or equipment you’d like to include, and whether you’re approaching a graduation or a final season. We can use those details to plan photographs that feel right to you.

During the week, I’m a senior executive at a digital media and advertising company. Much of that work involves listening, understanding what someone needs, and helping them make a decision they feel good about. I bring the same attention to my photography business. When you reach out, you’ll be talking with me. I’ll ask what you liked in my work, what you have in mind, and what would make the session a good experience for you. We’ll discuss the details and price before you decide to book.

I also write about family, fatherhood, and the people who shaped my life. Writing and photography both give me a reason to pay closer attention to people and their stories. You might be bringing your family together, finishing school, celebrating a season, or simply wanting a photograph of yourself that you like. I’d enjoy hearing what brings you here. You don’t need to arrive with a location, outfits, and every photograph already planned. We can work through those choices together.
about.closingHeadline: I’d like to hear a little about you, too.
about.closingCopy: Tell me who you’d like photographed and what brings you here. If you have a particular photograph in mind or a question about how a session would work, I’d like to hear it. We can talk before you decide to book.

families.headline: I photograph individuals and families in natural light.
families.intro: You might want portraits for yourself, photographs with your family, or a chance to be in the pictures you usually take. I’ll help you plan around the people coming, with a setting around Charlotte or Lake Norman and direction when we meet.

sections.headline: I'll help you plan portraits for yourself.
paragraphs: You don't need a graduation or a family occasion to have your portrait taken. You might need photographs for work, want to mark a change in your life, or simply want a photograph of yourself that you like. I'll ask where you plan to use the images and what you've liked in my work.

From there, we can talk about clothing and a setting where you'd feel comfortable. If being in front of the camera feels unfamiliar, I'll give you clear direction as we go. You won't be expected to arrive knowing how to pose.

sections.headline: I know there can be a lot to organize before a family session.
paragraphs: I'm part of a blended family with four children, so I understand the effort involved in getting everyone dressed and out the door. Tell me a little about your family before we meet, including anyone who might need more time to feel comfortable.
I'll keep the direction simple and give your family time to settle in. If grandparents are joining or there's a particular photograph you've been wanting, I'd like to know that too.

sections.headline: We can decide which photographs matter most before we meet.
paragraphs: For a family session, I'll ask about the combinations you'd like, including photographs with the person who is usually holding the camera. For an individual portrait, we'll talk about the different looks or uses you have in mind. Because I work with natural light, we'll consider the setting and time of day together. I'll include the agreed details in your quote so you can decide whether the session is right for you.

families.closingHeadline: Tell me a little about the photographs you'd like to have.
families.closingCopy: Let me know whether the session is for you or your family, roughly when you're thinking, and anything you'd like me to understand. I'll help you work through the details and send you a quote to consider before you book.

seniors.headline: I’ll help you plan portraits for your graduation.
seniors.intro: Whether you’re finishing high school, college, or a graduate program, I’d like to hear how you want to remember it. We can plan natural-light portraits around your clothing, interests, and the people you’d like included, with room for your own ideas.

sections.headline: I'll start by asking what you'd choose for yourself.
paragraphs: You may want the cap and gown, a favorite outfit, or a photograph somewhere you spent a lot of time. If a sport, a performance, or another part of your school experience belongs in the photographs, tell me about it. You don't need to arrive with a finished plan.

If you're a parent organizing the session, I'd like to hear what you hope to have and what your graduate wants too. As a parent myself, I understand wanting photographs for the family. I also want the person in them to have a say.

sections.headline: I'll help you include the people who helped you get here.
paragraphs: As a parent, I think about the people who have been cheering a graduate on, too. If you’d like a parent, a grandparent, a partner, or someone else beside you in a few photographs, I’d be glad to make that part of the plan.

If you're graduating after returning to school or balancing your studies with work and family, I'd love to hear about that too. I'll plan around your circumstances, whether you're coming on your own or sharing the occasion with others.

sections.headline: I'll talk through the practical details with you before you book.
paragraphs: We'll consider locations around Charlotte and Lake Norman, the natural light, and any clothing changes you have in mind. If you need photographs for announcements, a yearbook, or an invitation, tell me the deadline when you inquire. I'll confirm whether I can meet it before we agree on the session.

pricing.faqHeadline: A few things you may be wondering before you reach out
pricing.faqIntro: If your question isn’t answered here, you’re welcome to ask me directly. I’d like you to feel comfortable with the plan before you decide to book.

questions.question: How will I know the full price?
questions.answer: After we talk about your session, I’ll send a written quote covering the session length, location, edited images, and total cost, including any applicable taxes or agreed travel and venue costs. You’ll have time to read through it and ask questions before you decide to book.

questions.question: Do I need to choose a location before I contact you?
questions.answer: You’re welcome to suggest a place, but you don’t need to have one picked out. Tell me the kind of setting you like, and I’ll help you consider options around Charlotte and Lake Norman. We’ll plan around the natural light and confirm any access or location costs in advance.

questions.question: Can you help us decide what to wear?
questions.answer: Yes. Once we have a setting in mind, we can talk through colors and clothing that work well together. I want you to feel like yourself in the photographs, so we’ll start with clothes you feel comfortable wearing and work from there.

questions.question: What if my children need time to get comfortable?
questions.answer: Tell me a little about them when we plan. I have children of my own, and I know they don’t all warm up in the same way. We can plan a sensible amount of time, start with the easier photographs, and give them a chance to get used to me.

questions.question: What happens after I inquire?
questions.answer: I’ll ask about who’s coming, what you’re hoping for, and when you’d like the photographs. From there, we can discuss available dates, locations, and your quote. An inquiry gives us a place to start; it doesn’t reserve a date or commit you to a session.

questions.question: When will I receive my photographs?
questions.answer: I’ll confirm the delivery timeframe with you before you book. If you’re planning around announcements, a graduation party, or another deadline, mention it when you reach out so we can discuss what’s possible.

questions.question: Can I ask about prints?
questions.answer: Of course. Tell me if you’d like photographs for your walls, an album, or gifts for family. I’ll talk through the available options and explain what is included in your quote before you book.

pricing.closingHeadline: You can get in touch before you have every detail figured out.
pricing.closingCopy: Tell me who you’d like photographed and what you’re hoping for. I’ll help you plan the session and send you a quote you can consider without any commitment to book.

I loved how he set the scene first and got his framing before placing my son for pictures since he has a short fuse. He captured everything we wanted. He was fast, professional, and we are in LOVE with our pictures. Thank you so much Walt and we will be using you a lot in the future. I highly recommend him!!

testimonials.name: Mackenzie Lersch
testimonials.quote: I won a free shoot on Facebook and was so happy with what we got! We weren't even going to do Christmas pictures this year and we are so glad we did. So professional and such a good eye! Highly recommend

testimonials.name: Jessica Reynolds
testimonials.quote: Walt did fantastic work with family Christmas photos! He did an amazing job distracting a toddler and capturing great moments of my family. He takes time to capture the right photos and pays close attention to detail. We will definitely work with him again.

testimonials.name: Ruzzy Butalon Gross
testimonials.quote: Walter is a very professional photographer! He took very nice pictures to my family. Highly recommended.

testimonials.name: Amy Luisa
testimonials.quote: Walter has amazing talent! He did our Christmas photos this year and brought out such great features in all of us! You won't go wrong with choosing Walt Dublin Photography!

testimonials.name: Megan Kitzman
testimonials.quote: Walt was amazing with our family! We met him by accident and we couldn't have been more happy that we did! My son even took to him and listened so well when he would have him pose a certain way (he's 4). Our family Christmas picture came out stunning!! Thank you again for the last minute shoot!

testimonials.name: Allie Jean
testimonials.quote: Has a fantastic eye for angles. He is great with working with children, and has so much patience. He's enjoyable to work with, and I look forward to my session with him next month. I will be recommending him to everyone!

testimonials.name: Tia Minton
testimonials.quote: We had our shoot with Walter and it was great! We have a wild toddler and a cranky baby, Walter was very patient! Even with all of the chaos.. he was able to capture amazing moments of our family! Highly recommended and we will definitely be using him again!

testimonials.name: Kerri DeWit
testimonials.quote: Me and my best friend did a shoot last . Walter did a great job in making sure to capture it . Thank you so much

testimonials.name: Chelsea Diaz
testimonials.quote: We had a great time tonight at our shoot! Walter did a great job and was very patient and took the time to make sure we got the perfect moments! He has a great eye for the perfect shot! He made the shoot very comfortable and fun! Thank you for your time and for getting us some pretty great photos! Also thanks for dealing with our dogs when they literally did the opposite of what we asked! Haha! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great photographer!

testimonials.name: Bert Adams
testimonials.quote: He's great at capturing the moment!

testimonials.name: Christopher Odom
testimonials.quote: BEST Quality & Flexibility in photography in SRQ/Manatee area! hands down!! AMAZING work!!!

testimonials.name: Katrina Albro
testimonials.quote: We had a fantastic shoot last night with Walt Dublin Photography! He is very professional and took the time to make sure everything was perfect and just how I wanted them to turn out! We would highly recommend his services!

portfolio.headline: Some of the people I’ve had the pleasure of photographing.
portfolio.intro: I’ve put together photographs from different sessions so you can get a feel for my work. If you see something you’re drawn to, tell me when you get in touch. I’d like to know what caught your eye.
portfolio.closingHeadline: Is there a session you can picture yourself in?
portfolio.closingCopy: Tell me what you liked and who you’d like photographed. We can talk about how to make it work for you.

clients.headline: Your client gallery
clients.intro: Looking for photographs from a previous session? Please use the private gallery link sent to you, or email me if you need help finding it.
clients.helpHeadline: I can help you find the right gallery.
clients.helpCopy: Include the name used for the booking and the approximate session date when you get in touch.
clients.privacyNote: Please do not send gallery passwords through this site.

shared.invitationHeadline: Tell me what you have in mind.
shared.invitationCopy: You don’t need to have the location, outfits, or every detail decided. Tell me who you’d like photographed and roughly when, and we can take it from there.
shared.personalPortraitCaption: I’m usually on the other side of the camera.
shared.graduationLinkLabel: See how I can help you plan graduation photographs
shared.sportHeadline: Would you like to include your sport?
shared.sportCopy: I played football at Ohio State, so I understand why you might want photographs in your uniform as well as your cap and gown. We can discuss including your sport in a graduation session or planning dedicated athlete portraits.
shared.naturalLightNote: Because I specialize in natural light, we’ll consider the setting and time of day together. If you need to use a particular field or work around practice, tell me so we can talk through what will work.
